sequencing_guard: Do not interpret technical-entry ablations as full-strategy imitation evidence while required context domains remain incomplete. Context work must be isolated, causal, and evaluated out of sample before integration.

domains.name: Technical setup and confirmation trigger
domains.currently_modeled: Frozen micro-v0.1 evaluates pullback geometry, volume, support, momentum state, first-candle-new-high trigger and room to prior high.
domains.current_limit: The technical layer is evaluated after candidate qualification and cannot explain why Ross preferred or ignored a candidate.
evidence_needed: documented trade and skip behavior reserved for retrospective evaluation
domains.promotion_gate: No technical replacement may be promoted from the five labeled seed cases; it must improve representative out-of-sample behavior without activity inflation.

domains.name: Catalyst substance, novelty and materiality
causal_runtime_inputs: article metadata available by decision time
domains.currently_modeled: The scanner establishes provider-news presence as of decision time, and catalyst-timing-shadow-v0.1 derives provider-news chronology relative to market qualification without interpreting quality.
domains.current_limit: News presence does not classify economic substance, novelty, dilution risk, keyword stuffing or why the headline matters.
evidence_needed: the exact contemporaneous headline or filing
trade and skip examples with similar-looking news
domains.promotion_gate: Freeze a structured catalyst rubric from normative evidence, then validate a shadow-only scorer on held-out trade and skip examples.

domains.name: Obvious market leader and attention concentration
causal_runtime_inputs: number of active competing momentum stocks
domains.currently_modeled: The causal scanner records cross-sectional gain rank over its frozen membership, and attention-leadership-shadow-v0.1 derives threshold-free leadership, handoff, persistence, competition, and minute-change features for research only.
domains.current_limit: The general profile has no frozen top-N rule and rank alone does not establish where trader attention is concentrated.
domains.promotion_gate: Preregister a cross-sectional attention rule and validate it on a representative full-candidate panel without using later highs or outcomes.

domains.name: Daily-chart room, resistance and cleanliness
causal_runtime_inputs: split-adjusted daily bars available by decision time
domains.currently_modeled: Entry plans require approximately two units of reward room to a prior high.
domains.current_limit: A single prior-high calculation does not represent resistance clusters, gap-fill levels, repeated rejection or subjective chart cleanliness.
evidence_needed: pre-entry chart screenshots when commentary is ambiguous
accepted and rejected examples near resistance
domains.promotion_gate: Define a small evidence-backed set of daily-context features and test them as an isolated selection filter before any AI interpretation.

domains.name: Momentum regime, sector theme and sympathy context
causal_runtime_inputs: sector and issuer relationships known by decision time
domains.currently_modeled: The rulebook distinguishes cold, spark, hot and exhausted regimes.
domains.current_limit: No frozen causal regime state or theme-saturation score currently changes candidate selection or aggression.
evidence_needed: examples of sympathy trades and imitation-catalyst failures
domains.promotion_gate: Preregister a regime state machine on chronological data and validate transitions before allowing it to change size or participation.

domains.name: Spread, liquidity and achievable execution quality
domains.currently_modeled: Total volume, eligible trades and conservative fill/slippage checks exist.
domains.current_limit: Historical replay does not yet have a complete quote/depth model, so tradability and achievable size are only approximated.
evidence_needed: explicit commentary about spread or liquidity causing a trade or skip
domains.promotion_gate: Validate quote-based spread and fill-quality features before using modeled participation as evidence of executable imitation.

domains.name: Level 2, tape velocity and hidden liquidity
domains.currently_modeled: Eligible SIP prints are reconstructed for chart bars and modeled trigger fills.
domains.current_limit: SIP prints are not order-book depth and cannot show displayed sellers, queue position, replenishment or full tape context.
evidence_needed: explicit statements that tape changed the decision
domains.promotion_gate: Keep this domain deferred until synchronized historical depth or sufficiently precise visual evidence exists; never infer Level 2 from candles alone.

domains.name: Profit cushion, prior trades, discipline and aggression
causal_runtime_inputs: realized session PnL through decision time
domains.currently_modeled: Deterministic risk objects, giveback logic and terminal session lockouts exist.
domains.current_limit: The micro diagnostics do not carry full portfolio state, so repeated plans or fills are not Ross-like campaign and sizing decisions.
evidence_needed: statements linking aggression or restraint to prior trades
domains.promotion_gate: Integrate scanner, setup, position and session state on one causal replay before comparing aggression, re-entry or final PnL.
